ConnectionStrings.//: Production sets ConnectionStrings__Identity to Data Source=/data/nebulog.db; empty uses App_Data locally.

Admin.//: Seeded once if absent. Real values come from the deployment .env as NebuLog__Admin__Email / __Password.

DemoProducer.//: Set via NebuLog__DemoProducer__ApiKey in the deployment .env; only its hash is stored.

DataProtection.//: Must be writable. Production uses /data/keys because the container root filesystem is read-only.

Cors.//: Comma-separated origins allowed to POST /v1/logs from a browser. Empty allows none.

ForwardedHeaders.//: Comma-separated CIDR blocks whose CF-Connecting-IP header is trusted. Empty disables the feature.
